buyer_added_terms.text: 1. Generic Bidder shall submit the following documents along with their bid for Vendor Code Creation: a. Copy of PAN Card. b. Copy of GSTIN. c. Copy of Cancelled Cheque. d. Copy of EFT Mandate duly certified by Bank. 2. Generic Data Sheet of the product(s) offered in the bid, are to be uploaded along with the bid documents. Buyers can match and verify the Data Sheet with the product specifications offered. In case of any unexplained mismatch of technical parameters, the bid is liable for rejection. 3. Generic Installation, Commissioning, Testing, Configuration, Training (if any - which ever is applicable as per scope of supply) is to be carried out by OEM / OEM Certified resource or OEM authorised Reseller. 4. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 5. Generic Supplier shall ensure that the Invoice is raised in the name of Consignee with GSTIN of Consignee only. 6. Generic While generating invoice in GeM portal, the seller must upload scanned copy of GST invoice and the screenshot of GST portal confirming payment of GST. 7. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 8. Scope of Supply

Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Supply Installation Testing Commissioning of Goods and Training of operators and providing Statutory Clearances required (if any) 9. Certificates The bidder is required to upload, along with the bid, all relevant certificates such as BIS licence, type test certificate, approval certificates and other certificates as prescribed in the Product Specification given in the bid document. 10. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 11. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid. 12. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer uploaded ATC document Click here to view the file. 13. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Bidder to accept BEL incoterms as FOR – BEL Bangalore. 2. LD clause: if the seller/service provider fails to deliver any or all of the goods/services within the original/ re-fixed delivery period(s)specified in the contract, the buyer will be entitled to deduct/recover the liquidat ed damages for the delay, unless covered under force majeure conditions aforesaid, @ 0.5% of the contrac t value of delayed quantity per week or part of the week of delayed period as pre-estimated damages not exceeding 10% of the contract value of delayed quantity without any controversy/dispute of any sort what soever. 3. The bidder has to raise the invoice with GSTIN number as per contract order (buyer is not responsible if any mismatch in GSTIN between invoice and contract order). 4. Payment terms: 90% payment within 30 days after receipt, installation (if applicable) and acceptance of item at BEL-Bangalore, ePBG: Balance 10% payment after submission of 5% ePBG of total order value covering 2 months be yond the warranty Period. 5. Rejection if any shall be replaced within 1 month of receipt of information, failing which the amount has, already been made by BEL to the vendor shall be refunded 6. Warranty and Maintenance Support: a).All items forming part of the scope of supply shall have compreh ensive warranty for a period of 1 Year from the date of successful completion of the installation,testing, co mmissioning (Site Acceptance Test) & handing over of the complete system by the vendor to buyer. b).All the items shall be guaranteed against defective design, poor workmanship and defective material ofc onstruction. c).All the equipment/items shall be capable of performing the duties specified in this specification without damage, distortion of failure of any component.

d).The vendor shall repair and replace any parts of the equipment supplied by vendor at his own expenses during warranty period. e).Break down maintenance aspect of the system during the warranty period will be attended on call basis after fault reporting from buyer and the same should be rectified/replaced (if not rectifiable) within 48 hrs f rom time of reporting of the fault. Adequate spares may be maintained by vendor for the same. f).Quarterly preventive maintenance visits and emergency visit as and when required are to be undertaken . 7. GST clause:- i) Basic invoice value will be released as per the terms of payment and GST amount will be released only after the same is reflected in BEL GST portal (GSTR2B) and taxes are paid by the supplier to the government. ii) Costs including interest and penalty incurred by BEL due to non-payment & non-reporti ng of taxes in th e government portal, by the supplier, will be recovered from the supplier. 8. The item to be supplied as per the attached technical specifications provided in buyer added ATC sectio n. 9. Bidders must provide a point-to-point technical compliance statement matching every serial number of BEL’s technical specifications. This statement must include the exact details and values of the offered prod uct, presented in a separate column on the bidder's official letterhead, duly signed and sealed. 10. Item brochure/product catalogues and certificates of the product must be submitted along with the bid documents. 11. Bidder has to provide GST % rate applicable for the item in price bid format excel sheet (provided with bid). 12. Bidder contact details such as valid phone number and email id to be provided along with bid docume nts for correspondence. 13. For any further help/queries kindly contact below: email id: captpurcmm@bel.co.in, phone no: 080-22 195448. .
